reader.requirement: At --std 85 the USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION/ERROR PROCEDURE statement (Report Writer arm: file-name-1, OUTPUT, EXTEND) is a declaration only: it is never executed as a statement, execution starts at the first nondeclarative procedure, and its section runs only when the exception condition arises or the section is PERFORMed (then only the paragraphs run).

edition-consulted.switches: Format 3/4 (EXCEPTION CONDITION, EXCEPTION OBJECT) refused below 2002; USE without AFTER / without PROCEDURE refused below 2002

reader.edition-search: The never-executed half is structural: DeclCollectSection consumes the first sentence's USE into a BoundDeclarative (scope) and never hands it to the statement binder; CollectParagraphs sets the entry pc after the declaratives. Grepped ProcedureTableBuilder.cs for Edition/DialectLevel/Has( in DeclCollectSection/DeclBindUse: none on this path (only the USE FOR DEBUGGING arm reads configuration).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the execution model of the USE statement is the same; only the 2002 formats (F3/F4, optional AFTER/PROCEDURE) are refused at 85
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb365_report_group_qualified_85 exercises a USE BEFORE REPORTING declarative only; nothing exercises a USE AFTER EXCEPTION declarative on a report file at 85, the OUTPUT mode arm, or a PERFORM of a USE section

probes.printed: START / ERR-DECL FS=30 / AFTER OPEN FS=30 / BR-DECL H=1 / BR-DECL H=2 / ERR-DECL FS=30 / H=2
probes.expected: execution begins at MAIN (START first), the USE AFTER ERROR ON RPT procedure runs once after the failed OPEN OUTPUT and control returns to the next statement; PERFORM of each USE section runs only its paragraphs

probes.printed: START / ERR-DECL FS=30 / AFTER OPEN FS=30 / BR-DECL H=1 / BR-DECL H=2 / ERR-DECL FS=30 / H=2
probes.expected: USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION PROCEDURE ON OUTPUT selects the failed OPEN OUTPUT of the report file the same way

probes.printed: error COBOL0878 (EC-I-O introduced by 2002); error COBOL0877 USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: the 1985 format prints only USE AFTER STANDARD {EXCEPTION|ERROR} PROCEDURE ON {file-name-1...|OUTPUT|EXTEND}: refuse the 2002 Format 3

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.8.3 SR2  (4.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: The USE statement is consumed as a declaration by DeclCollectSection and never reaches StatementBinder; a USE bound there is refused as misplaced (COBOL2377). The probe shows the run begins at the first nondeclarative procedure, the declarative is entered only on the qualifying failed OPEN, and a PERFORM of the section executes only its procedures.
